title: US equity, options and bond markets closed — Thanksgiving Day (the year's shortest closure, and the one whose Wednesday carries five confirmed prints)
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 by this event's own initial research (HTTP 200 after its 302, 109,180 bytes; the page needs curl -L and its holiday data is JSON-ish '"text":"..."' cells rather than table markup) and parsed cell by cell rather than inherited from the proposal. The Thanksgiving Day row parses as ['Thursday, November 26***', 'Thursday, November 25***', 'Thursday, November 23*** '] for 2026 / 2027 / 2028, so 2026 is a full closure on Thursday November 26 with no observance shift; footnote *** reads verbatim 'Each market will close early at 1:00 p.m. (1:15 p.m. for eligible options) on Friday, November 27, 2026, Friday, November 26, 2027, and Friday, November 24, 2028 (the day after Thanksgiving). NYSE American Equities, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE National, and NYSE Texas late trading sessions will close at 5:00 p.m. All times are Eastern Time.' RE-CORROBORATED FROM TWO FURTHER PRIMARIES THIS SESSION: the OCC's own expiration calendar (www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) marks 2026-11-26 {"holiday":{"description":"Exchange/OCC holiday","hatched":true}} — the same file reserves the unhatched 'Bank holiday' label for bond-only days such as 2026-11-11 — and SIFMA's US Holiday Recommendations panel (sifma.org/resources/guides-playbooks/holiday-schedule, HTTP 200, 299,272 bytes) gives 'Thanksgiving Day | Thursday, November 26, 2026' a full fixed-income close with the note 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, November 27, 2026'. Reproduced by statute and weekday arithmetic: 5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes Thanksgiving on the FOURTH Thursday of November, and November 2026's Thursdays are the 5th, 12th, 19th and 26th. Filed estimate on the two counts every sibling closure entry documents — the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an exchange's or a trade association's own holiday calendar, and this lane may not self-confirm. The DATE is not in doubt; the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-09), per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md's rule for an id that existed only as a sibling's proposal. The one proposal it shadows — proposals/thanksgiving-market-closure-2026-11-26.from-christmas-market-closure-2026-12-25.json — was read first and stays where it is; every primary above was re-fetched rather than inherited. WHAT THIS RESEARCH ADDED THAT THE PROPOSAL DID NOT HAVE. (1) THE CLOSURE IS THE YEAR'S SHORTEST, WHICH IS THE OPPOSITE OF HOW IT READS. Continuous market-shut time, computed from NYSE hours: Wed 2026-11-25 16:00 ET to Fri 2026-11-27 09:30 ET is 41.5 hours, against 65.5 for an ordinary weekend, 89.5 for Labor Day 2026-09-07 and 92.5 for Christmas 2026-12-25. Thanksgiving is the only US full closure that sits mid-week with a session on both sides, so the market is shut 24 hours LESS than it is every weekend. (2) AND YET ITS VOL MARK-DOWN IS THE LARGEST OF THE TEN US CLOSURES. Measured this session on CBOE VIX closes 1990-2025 with FRED's Nasdaq series as the session filter: VIX falls 5.83% mean / 6.56% median over the four sessions into the Wednesday before Thanksgiving, down in 25 of 35 years (p = 0.017 against a 52.4% unconditional base over 9,229 four-session windows). The same window measured at every US equity closure is negative at 8 of 10 (Presidents -5.31%, July 4 -5.60%, Christmas -5.81%, Thanksgiving -5.83%). So the mark tracks the ONE trading day each closure removes from VIX's 30-calendar-day window, not the wall-clock length of the shutdown. THIS CORRECTS THE LABEL ON A SIBLING FINDING: christmas-market-closure-2026-12-25 titled the same shape 'the turn-of-year vol re-mark'; it reproduces a month earlier with no year-end present, so it is a closure effect. That ledger's stated MECHANISM (calendar-day decay accounting, which it flagged as inference) is strengthened by the replication; only its seasonal attribution fails. (3) THE RELEASE COMPRESSION IS CAUSAL, WHICH IS THE OPEN QUESTION THAT SIBLING HANDED FORWARD. Its leg 4 established the stack and said explicitly that whether agencies pull releases forward BECAUSE of the closure was not tested. Tested here against a primary that depends on no holiday calendar: api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov auctions_query, 6,023 auctions since 2009. The 4-Week and 8-Week bills have priced on a Thursday 96.5% of the time since 2019, and in 7 of 7 Thanksgiving weeks in that era the entire slate moved to the Wednesday before; ZERO auctions of any kind have been held on Thanksgiving Thursday in 17 consecutive years. Treasury moves for the closure. (4) A DATED PROMOTION PATH NO SIBLING CLOSURE ENTRY HAS. TSY: is already in CONFIRMED_PREFIX (scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs line 15), and Treasury announces the displaced Wednesday slate one day ahead in Thanksgiving weeks (2023-11-21, 2024-11-26, 2025-11-25). So primary TSY: evidence naming 2026-11-25 becomes available on about 2026-11-24 — the first date this entry can be promoted on evidence rather than on a taxonomy ruling. IMPACT low and symbols [] follow every sibling US trading-hours entry: a scheduled closure 78 days out moves no price and licenses nothing, and a re-grep of docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md this session for holiday|thanksgiving|black.?friday|half.?day|early.?close|closure returns ZERO hits in both, so nothing in the house system can fire on this date in either direction. Estimate widens caution and licenses no entry. Full ledger: docs/research/events/thanksgiving-market-closure-2026-11-26.md
